The company aims to facilitate seamless and enjoyable travel experiences by offering tailored group booking services, including dedicated contact personnel, meal options on board, and the ability to reserve before the standard booking period opens. Its target market includes schools, businesses, and travel agencies looking to organize group trips across Europe, with popular destinations such as Paris, London, and Amsterdam. SNCB International partners with various train operators, including Eurostar and TGV, to provide a comprehensive range of travel options, ensuring that clients benefit from competitive pricing and flexible travel arrangements. Name: TUC RAIL

With a strong emphasis on employee development and a supportive work environment, TUC RAIL fosters a culture of communication and autonomy, making it an attractive workplace for professionals in the field. The company is also dedicated to diversity and inclusivity, welcoming individuals from all backgrounds to join its mission of enhancing transportation infrastructure.

Name: Lineas
Company description: Lineas est le plus grand opérateur privé de fret ferroviaire en Europe, spécialisé dans le transfert de marchandises de la route vers le rail, contribuant ainsi à réduire les émissions de CO2 de 90 %. L'entreprise s'engage à rendre les chaînes d'approvisionnement climatiquement neutres et joue un rôle stratégique dans la logistique européenne, soutenue par des partenariats avec des acteurs majeurs tels que BASF et PSA Antwerp. Lineas vise à renforcer la compétitivité industrielle en Belgique et en Europe, tout en poursuivant une transformation interne pour améliorer sa rentabilité et sa performance financière. Avec près de 1700 employés, Lineas est déterminée à devenir un leader dans le transport ferroviaire durable et à répondre aux besoins croissants de ses clients dans divers secteurs économiques.

Name: Benerail
Company description: Our mission? benerail makes it possible to easily book international train travel through Europe. No more manually trying to piece together international train trips. Via our unique API platform, we make the booking process simple, accessible, stress-free and crystal clear. How it works? Just type in your journey’s starting point located in “country A” and its destination in “country B”, and immediately be shown all possible train combination options – along with their total travel times and prices. The chosen option is then booked as one single ticket to be used throughout the whole journey. Basically, we do the work for you – to save you valuable time and money. Why partner with us? * increase client base by offering one international train travel platform * incredibly user-friendly API platform, with integrated functionality for scheduling, inventory management, pricing, distribution and ticketing * instant access to multiple European railway carriers and their destinations * content from various railway carriers and inventory systems combined for seamless comparison and booking * access to a standardized solution When the national railway companies from Belgium and the Netherlands in 2003 decided to start a joint venture to combine and integrate their strengths to make booking and travelling easier, benerail was born. Going outside comfort zones is the core of collaborating on mutual terms; for the benefit of travellers in Europe that embark on a cross country journey with a single ticket. Now, nearly two decades later, benerail is ready to connect all European destinations with the ambition to deliver climate-neutral travel in the 'flight shame zone' under 800 km. Topics that are related to the business of benerail: climate-neutral travel, green transportation, railway ticket technology, travel management companies, travel agencies, self booking tools, online booking tools, eco-friendly travel, OSDM, ETCD, multimodal travel, trains, railway undertakings.

Name: ALLRAIL The Alliance Of Passenger Rail New Entrants

Company description: ALLRAIL, the Alliance of Rail New Entrants, brings together non-incumbent companies from the passenger rail market comprising operators like European Sleeper, RegioJet, Transdev, WESTbahn, Leo Express, NTV-Italo, Flixtrain, multimodal journey planner and online booking platform Trip.com, rolling stock lessor Angel Trains, and infrastructure manager Getlink.  All our members share the belief that further market liberalisation is the only way to achieve a modal shift to rail and help the European Union (EU) achieve the ambitious targets laid down in the 2016 Paris Climate Agreement. Around Europe, it has been proven that an open rail market leads to:  - innovation and improved service  - lower fares  - passenger growth, and  - new jobs.  For example, since NTV-Italo began competing against the incumbent Trenitalia in the Italian high-speed market in 2012, average fares have fallen by 41% while demand increased by 101%. The incumbent is more profitable than before, and both operators have introduced new trains. In addition, wherever competitive tendering has been introduced for publicly-funded rail services, taxpayer cost has decreased, and quality has improved.  While all stakeholders - passengers, taxpayers, the rail sector and legislators - benefit from liberalisation, over 80% of EU passenger rail does not experience any form of competition, so there is a lot of work still to be done. Four points are to address in priority to encourage market opening: 1) Lowering track-access charges, 2) Ensuring a vibrant market for new and second-hand rolling-stock, 3) Fixing ticket retail (availability of all data, transparent and impartial retail, FRAND conditions for independent ticket vendors), 4) Public Service Obligations as a last resort, and only through competitive tenders.

Name: Rijschool Segers

Company description: INTERNATIONAAL TRANSPORT Heeft u een betrouwbare partner nodig voor uw internationaal transport? Wij verzorgen uw transport door gans Europa. Name: Global Ukraine Rail Task Force
HQ Location: Belgium, Brussels Capital, Brussels, 40 Rue Washington, 1050
Company description: After Russia’s unprovoked and brutal invasion of Ukraine, a group of rail experts came together and created the Global Ukraine Rail Task Force.   The Task Force is an advisory body and the members are all volunteers working in individual capacities.    The primary task of the Global Ukraine Rail Task Force is to provide a roundtable to analyse the impact of Russia’s aggressive invasion on Ukraine’s rail sector and to seek solutions. The twin goals are to address the humanitarian crisis enveloping the rail sector as well as rebuilding the rail infrastructure to replace war damage and meet the long term needs of a democratic Ukraine linked to the West. The Task Force's four objectives are: 1) Address the humanitarian crisis,       2) Rebuild the Ukrainian rail sector infrastructure, 3) Address passenger rail capacity, 4) Maximise freight capacity. The Task Force is chaired by: Jolene Molitoris; Former Administrator of the United States Federal Railroad Administration Nick Brooks; Secretary General of the Alliance of Passenger Rail New Entrants in Europe – ALLRAIL.

Name: V-Step Bvba
Company description: V-Step is een West-Vlaamse onderneming geleid door 3 jonge ondernemers. De onderneming is actief binnen het personentransport en zet meer bepaald in op het gebruik van de elektrische step of e-step. De e-step is een nieuw concept op een bestaande basis. De e-step verschilt van zijn klassieke tegenhanger omdat deze elektrisch wordt aangedreven. Dit verhoogt de snelheid en het gebruiksgemak. Een volledig opgeladen exemplaar heeft een bereik van verschillende tientallen kilometers. De steps halen een topsnelheid van 18 tot 25 kilometer per uur.  V-Step richt zich op drie belangrijke pijlers met betrekking tot e-steps. De eerste pijler is het verkopen van e-steps en overige benodigdheden. Dit gebeurt via onze online winkel die te vinden is op www.v-step.be.  Onze tweede pijler bestaat uit de exploitatie van deelsteps onder de Troty merknaam. Deelsteps zijn elektrische steps die verspreid staan in een stad of een uitgestrekte site. Gebruikers kunnen via de Troty-app (te downloaden in de Apple store & Google Play store) de dichtste e-step terugvinden en ontgrendelen. Eens ontgrendeld kan de gebruiker rijden naar de gekozen locatie. Eens aangekomen kan de gebruiker uitloggen en de step veilig achterlaten. Het voordeel van dit concept is de flexibiliteit.
